dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Ooh, let's get some of this! It looks fresh!

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Alright, some of this to go, please.

dialogues.speaker: Shevirme
dialogues.text: You got it! Taking it home with you? For two, right?

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: For tw— Oh! N—No, no, no, no, no. It's not... We don't...

dialogues.speaker: Kaveh
dialogues.text: Just... one serving each! Separate! Not together!

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Light on the sauce for mine, please.

dialogues.speaker: Shevirme
dialogues.text: No problem! Any preference for you, sir?
